summary.tldr: Adds sentencing rules for weapons offences near hospitals and blocks drug exemptions that would allow illicit use in hospitals.
what_it_does: Requires courts to treat it as an aggravating circumstance when a person convicted under Criminal Code section 88 had a weapon in or near a hospital, on or near hospital grounds, or in or near another public health care facility.
Prevents the Minister from granting a Controlled Drugs and Substances Act exemption that would result in the illicit or unprescribed use of a controlled substance in a hospital.
Confirms that this ban does not apply to prescribed use of a controlled substance in a hospital by a patient, if a practitioner authorizes and supervises it.
summary.background: The bill amends section 88 of the Criminal Code and section 56 of the Controlled Drugs and Substances Act.
